item.tib: rtsa gsum bder 'dus kyi rtsa rlung sngon 'gro mi ldog thar pa'i mtshams sbyor
item.coloph: de ltar rtsa rlung theg pa'i sgor 'jug pa'i thabs lam 'di nyid/ bon sgo gzhan la rigs su 'dres nas/ sngon 'gro'i tshig bshad 'di dag lha mchog rig 'dzin chen po de nyid nyin snang mtshan 'khrul sogs la 'bral ba med pa'i kho bo bde chen snying po'am/ lung zin gsang mtshan g.yung drung thogs med rtsal du 'bod pa bdag gis/ snang sems zung 'jug ngang du shar grol smin gling du sbyar ba'o/ rig 'dzin bla ma lha dang mkha' 'gro la/ nyes 'gal gzu lum gyur nas mthol zhing bshags/ nyes legs ltang 'dzin dam can gter bdag bzhis/ bzod gsol bzhes la sdong grogs g.yel med mdzod/ dge bas ma gyur 'gro ba sems can rnams/ gsang sems zung 'jug lha skur grol bar shog bkra shis bon bstan dge legs 'phel rgyas shog/
